label.explanation: Order-service picked up config revision 479, which changed PAYMENT_SVC_URL to port 9090 (lines 238, 247). payment-svc doesn't listen there, so every call is refused immediately (lines 256, 259, 264, 275) — not a timeout, and payment-svc itself is healthy (its routine logs continue). The api-gateway 503s are the symptom (lines 252, 258, 270, 278, 281, 288, 291, 299, 308, 311, 317, 321). The config revision shipped with the order-service v5.24.0 deploy, so bad_deploy is defensible, but the fault is the config value. Red herrings: lines 108, 109 (a single card processor connection reset that succeeded on retry, minutes before onset); lines 209, 216 (a deploy of order-consumer, which is not on the failing request path and kept processing normally); line 253 (a one-off slow reporting query on audit_log, not on the failing request path); line 251 (a client sending one invalid request, rejected correctly with a 400).
